name: sio
comment: Targeted grammar: covers tokens that would otherwise mislead if highlighted as Rust (see former website/src/remark/remark-sio-as-rust.mjs, removed). Keyword list ground-truthed against self-hosted/lexer/tables.sio, 2026-08-17. Not a complete port of ecosystem/sounio-vscode or tools/editors/vscode grammars, which have drifted from each other and from the lexer.

exclusive-ref-operator.comment: &! is Sounio's own exclusive-reference operator, distinct from &. It must never be tokenized as a broken/partial &mut — Sounio has no &mut. Colored with the Mut effect token: taking an exclusive ref is what makes mutation possible.
exclusive-ref-operator.name: keyword.operator.exclusive-ref.sio

concat-operator.comment: ++ is array/sequence concatenation in Sounio, not increment (Sounio has no increment operator).
concat-operator.name: keyword.operator.concat.sio

effect-clause.comment: `with Effect1, Effect2 { ... }` declares algebraic effects on a function signature. Highlight `with` as control flow, not as a Rust trait-bound `where`-adjacent token.
effect-clause.name: keyword.control.effect-clause.sio

effect-names.comment: The 9 algebraic effects (CLAUDE.md section 7). Each gets its own scope so it can bind to cursor-1's per-effect token (--color-effect-io etc.) rather than the generic type-name color. Must be included before #type-names so these win on overlap.

linear-affine-modifier.comment: `linear struct` / `affine struct` are ownership-discipline modifiers with no Rust equivalent. Bound to --color-type-linear, which cursor-1's token set already reserves for exactly this.
linear-affine-modifier.name: storage.modifier.ownership.sio

storage-let.comment: `let` is an immutable binding — semantically the certain/verified half of Sounio's let/var split, unlike Rust where `let` alone says nothing about mutability.
storage-let.name: storage.type.immutable.sio

storage-var.comment: `var` is Sounio's own mutable-binding keyword (not `let mut`). Bound to the Mut effect color: introducing a var is what the Mut effect tracks.
storage-var.name: storage.modifier.mutable.sio

unit-annotation.comment: Dimensional-unit suffixes on numeric literals, e.g. `500.0mg`, `2.5kg` — a Sounio-specific literal form with no Rust analogue.
unit-annotation.name: keyword.other.unit.sio

macro-like-call.comment: Sounio has no macros. An identifier immediately followed by `!` is not a macro invocation the way `println!`/`assert!` are in Rust; do not give it macro styling — fold it into plain function-call highlighting instead.
macro-like-call.name: entity.name.function.sio

operators.comment: No unary-minus rule is defined on purpose: `-x` is not valid Sounio (write `0 - x`), so `-` is only ever tokenized as the plain binary operator below, never as a prefix/unary operator class.
operators.name: keyword.operator.sio
